values.message:
Hey Cook's team,

My daughter and I build websites for service businesses. Reading your reviews, people keep saying they've called you for decades, and one called you because his grandparents always did. That's exactly what our method is built around, so we made you a website mockup:

https://cooks.websitepreview.fluidframemarketing.com/

Note: It'll look a lot better with your logo and images on it! Lol

The preview opens with a recent case study, then explains the thinking behind every page and how it gets more people to find you and pick up the phone. For example, on a phone your current site takes 6 to 7 seconds to show its main content, about 2 to 3 times Google's "good" mark of 2.5 seconds, and your homepage has no main headline, so Google and AI never learn what you do or where.

By the way, our contact form system would have recognized this as a solicitation, and you wouldn't have even seen it.

How'd we do on your company vibe?

Josh
Fluid Frame Marketing
